messages:
alex: Starting a regional kernel+quant sweep across us-east/us-west/eu-west.
Run id: run-20260318-2110
Quick summary: A100/H100/L4, kernels: triton-fused, flash-attn, causal-fused. Observing p95 spike in us-west for A100 when routed via edge-pop-3.

maria: Can you paste p50/p95 and batch configs? Also which model and quant? 

kevin: Model: redmodel-3B (gpt-like), eval prompt length ~120 tokens, batch=1/4/16 runs. Quant: fp16, q4_k_m, nf4-8 (for L4). Short numbers from run-id:
A100 fp16 (batch=1): us-east p50 48ms p95 110ms; us-west p50 55ms p95 160ms; eu-west p50 60ms p95 140ms.
H100 fp16 (batch=1): us-east 42/95; us-west 46/110; eu-west 52/108.
L4 q4 (batch=1): us-east 38/130; us-west 44/220; eu-west 40/150.

perf-bot: Automated aggregate (10k reqs): overall qps=830, avg_gpu_util=72%, p50=45ms, p95=128ms. Cold-KV ratio ~12%.

sylvia: Noting pattern: us-west p95 much worse on L4 and A100 when routed via edge-pop-3. Trace shows extra ~20-80ms network hop from edge-pop backhaul + serialization on that pop. Flash-attn kernels reduce p95 on H100 by ~12ms in eu-west vs triton-fused.

jamal: Hypothesis: cold KV cache + small backhaul spikes cause p95 tails in us-west. Also L4 q4 decoder exhibits higher variance at p95 under concurrent batches 4/16.

maria: Any config snippet to try sticky routing to nearest-pop or fallback to regional? 

alex: config snippet we used:
```
route_policy:
  - condition: region == "us-west"
    prefer: nearest_pop
    fallback: regional_pool(us-west)
    sticky: 60s
```

kevin: Proposed follow-ups: 1) Run cold vs warmed KV tests (30m each) 2) Run sticky routing canary in us-west for 1h 3) Kernel-only sweep on H100 with flash vs triton on eu-west (small batch sizes)

alex: I'll kick off KV cold/warm and the sticky routing canary this afternoon. I'll post updated p50/p95 + per-kernel CSV when done.

maria: SGTM :thumbsup:
